jobs.occupation: Head of NATO HQ Fire and Emergency Services M/W/X
jobs.description:
SUMMARY 

The Head of Fire and Emergency Services, leads and manages a team of professional emergency responders, who are ready to respond to fire, medical and other emergencies at NATO Headquarters. They are the principal advisor for all policy, operational, planning and technical aspects of fire prevention and fire-fighting, emergency medical response, Chemical, Biological, Radiological and Nuclear (CBRN) and evacuation drills.

This position is based at NATO Headquarters in Brussels. It requires flexibility to work outside normal working hours.

Apply here by 13 September: https://bit.ly/4qP8DOV 
 
 
QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE
The incumbent must:

• possess a university degree, or an equivalent level of qualification relevant to the position;
• have at least 5 years of experience managing a team of professional firefighters;
• have a degree in crisis management or any other recognized advanced certificate specializing in firefighting and/or incident management/ emergency response, from a national fire prevention or civil protection body;
• have extensive experience as a professional firefighter and Emergency Management, Emergency planning and disaster recovery/ business continuity.
• possess the following minimum levels in the official languages of NATO (English/ French): V ("Advanced") in one and III ("Intermediate") in the other.
The following would be considered assets:

• experience in developing and implementing fire prevention, first-aid and emergency response training programs to professionnals, clients/community;
• have excellent knowledge of CBRN incident response procedures, rescue technics (Grimp); and
• knowledge of general occupational health and safety regulations and construction safety prevention.

jobs.occupation: Become a Forklift Operator at a Sustainable Recycling Company
jobs.description:
As a forklift operator, you’ll join an innovative plastic recycling company where sustainability and circular economy are at the heart of what we do. In this role, you’ll be responsible for moving plastic waste around the site, loading and unloading trucks, and performing minor technical maintenance. Your work directly contributes to recycling plastic and building a greener future.

On a typical workday, you’ll work in one of two shifts: early shift from 5 AM to 2 PM, or late shift from 2 PM to 11 PM (sometimes 3 PM to 12 AM), always with a one-hour break. You’ll use a wheel loader and forklift to efficiently process plastic waste. Flexibility is important, as the shift schedule can vary slightly. Please note, the nature of recycling means the work environment can be less clean and sometimes involve odors. You’ll handle small technical issues yourself, while a maintenance technician is available for larger problems.

Are you ready to put your technical skills to good use and make a positive impact on the environment? Apply now and make a difference as an operator in the recycling industry!

• You have a valid forklift license

• You speak good English; knowledge of Dutch is an asset

• You have technical knowledge and can handle minor repairs or maintenance

• You’re flexible for early and late shift work

• Experience in a similar role is a plus, but not required

• You work accurately and value safety
